sections.text:
・Recovers 16 Ability Cost for all allies.
└Cost recovery effect boosted by 1 for each increase in Skill level.
・Increases ATK and MATK of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
・Removes status ailments from all allies.
・Increases the ATK and MATK of your character by 20% for 60 seconds.
・Increases the ATK buff limit of your character by 20% for 80 seconds.
・Increases the MATK buff limit of your character by 20% for 80 seconds.
